_comment: Synthetic air handler without its airflow point (generator ahu_excess_oa; 0.108, #195): the same columns as synthetic_ahu_excess_oa.json, read as a BAS with no supply airflow station would trend the unit, so SA_CFM is left unmapped. The excess-outside-air estimate then needs the unit's supply_airflow_cfm (or design_oa_cfm) from the config's loads.
